headline: Comprehensive Home Remodel with Permits & Architectural Challenges
articleBody:
Doron Malka hired Diditan for a major remodel involving complex permits and structural issues; Arie Abekasis's team managed all aspects, from design to execution. diditangroup+1

Outcome: House became more beautiful, functional, and cost-effective than planned; client "highly highly recommends" with exceptional experience overall. diditangroup+1
